mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, message, link, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{link}, FALSE, NOW())
